label: Connecting ridge B
source: LOLA 40 m south polar DEM (240 m distant terrain); 20 m sampling, not 20 m native terrain resolution
projection: south polar stereographic, R=1737.4 km, x east, y toward lon 0, row 0 = +y

horizon.encoding: gzip; byte deltas between consecutive azimuth layers (mod 256); elevations clamped to -8..17.5 deg as in field_pole
horizon.layout: uint8 [azimuthBin][row][col], azimuth from local north toward east

slope.layout: uint8 [layer][row][col]; layer 0 = mean slope deg * 4, layer 1 = % of cell under 10 deg
